title: Modern Horizons 3 Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane whose weather shifts to assail would-be invaders.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: A nature deity; when she speaks, all of nature falls silent.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: A being who experiences reality on his own terms, revered by the Eternal Pilgrims.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: High priest of the Eternal Pilgrims.

entities.name: Eternal Pilgrims
entities.description: A religious order led by high priest Ayli.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who works alongside Skreeg.

entities.name: Skreeg
entities.description: An associate of Ral Zarek who meddles with things, sometimes successfully.

entities.name: Kudo, King Among Bears
entities.description: A bear king born from the greatest granite boulder and crowned amid a raging blizzard.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A land whose landscape a wight knew well, prized by her demonic overlords.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: A realm with a once-prosperous town now reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A place whose surrounding waters are polluted by a warped gateway.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with an underground paradise beneath its surface.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane that is home to fearsome trolls.

entities.name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah
entities.description: Ajani as a nacatl pariah, denied by his pride but not by his brother.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A leader concerned about dwindling troop recruitment.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's associate, whom he addresses about recruitment.

events.summary: Ral Zarek scolds Skreeg for meddling, then realizes Skreeg's tinkering worked.
events.quote: "Skreeg! I thought I told you to stop messing with... Oh, that worked. Good job, Skreeg."

events.summary: Kudo is born from a granite boulder and crowned king amid a blizzard.
events.quote: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

events.summary: Urza tells Tawnos that recruitment is failing and a new strategy is needed.
events.quote: "Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy."

relations.quote: —Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

rejected.summary: A town in Vantress is swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.
rejected.quote: Once a prosperous Vantress town, now swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.
A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.
